method.rule: The mindset and two structural patterns are adapted; the workflow is not. Upstream's skills are phase machines with mandatory reference reads and completion contracts — more prescriptive than what this tool is moving away from — so none of that shape is taken. What is taken is stated per derivation below.
method.reviewNote: Read at this revision on 2026-08-26. The whole plugin was read before anything was written, and most of it was deliberately declined.

retained: one solved problem per record, written durably after the work
a corpus read as grounding before new work rather than after failing
the loop is the point: run one teaches it, run two remembers
modified: a learning carries the maintainer's own words, because it outlives every fence
it is a flat directory read by the brief's index line, not a documentation tree
no interactive/non-interactive mode split, no depth selector, no subagent phase
derivations.note: The mechanism is ours; the observation that a record ending with its bundle guarantees the same wall gets hit twice is theirs.

retained: stance, then a concrete protocol with the actual commands
an invocation contract: what the caller needs back, in the caller's terms
a stated reporting shape so the caller is not parsing prose
modified: the reviewer never receives the implementer's reasoning, which is this tool's own rule
silence is not success: a personality that found nothing says what it looked for
derivations.note: The four-part shape is upstream's and is the reason their agent briefs produce work rather than opinion. The concrete personalities shipped here — adversary, standards, spec — are this tool's own verification lenses written into that shape.

declined.why: Phase machines with mandatory-read-at-this-step reference contracts and a completion contract per output tier. This is the over-strictness the maintainer is removing, not an alternative to it.
Out of scope for this round by the maintainer's decision.
